gates.G2: stocks with Calmar(long_rev) > Calmar(long): sign test p < alpha/2

reported: per stock CAGR, max DD, Calmar, Sharpe, ruin for long, long + reverse, buy and hold
share of stocks with positive CAGR; beating buy and hold on Calmar
